card.name: Just before the letters 'arg' completes a word
card.fires_on: Responds to a word piece that comes right before a closing 'arg' or 'arga', as in 'leth' before 'argy' or 'MYLOT' before 'ARG'. It also fires on '(' after AVPR1a before 'arginine'.

modes.label: Lethargy
modes.description: The first part of 'lethargy' in lists of overdose symptoms.
modes.example: nausea, vomiting, dehydration, electrolyte imbalances, dizziness, abdominal pain,<< leth>>argy and incoordination.

modes.label: Brand names ending in ARG
modes.description: The middle of brand names such as MYLOTARG or STIVARGA, just before the 'ARG' ending.
modes.example: Discontinue use of MY<<LOT>>ARG in patients who develop signs or symptoms

card.writes: It promotes argument-like tokens such as 'arg', 'args' and 'argument', so it pushes the model toward continuing with 'arg'.
card.plain: It fires when a word is about to finish with 'arg', like lethargy or Mylotarg.
